name: B10-0503/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 16 October 2025 amending Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2429 as regards origin labelling for fruit and vegetables originating in the non-self-governing territory of Western Sahara
part_text:
The European Parliament is objecting to a new European Commission rule on how fruit and vegetables from Western Sahara are labelled. Under the rule, these products would show the region where they were harvested instead of naming Western Sahara as the country of origin. The Parliament says this breaks European Union law and a court ruling, and could mislead shoppers about where their food really comes from. It wants the rule stopped.

- **What changes:** If allowed, labels would show a region name, not Western Sahara, as the place of origin.
- **Who it affects:** Shoppers buying fresh fruit and vegetables, and importers of goods from Western Sahara.
- **What happens next:** Parliament tells the Commission the rule cannot take effect; the Commission must respond.
